title: Preserve Help share cards when page metadata replaces the parent block
detail: Live /help and /help/changelog return no og:image while their inherited Twitter Help image still exists. Each page replaces openGraph with page copy but does not carry the parent file-convention images; the category template uses the same pattern. Resolve parent metadata and retain its exact image descriptors/URLs, with the existing static brand image as a fallback, and give Twitter the page-specific copy. Keep per-article file cards untouched. Local implementation passes 24 tests in four Help/schema/raster suites, actual metadata-export probes for all three callers, SEO guard and lint. Four assertion-level synthetic regressions all fail. Whole-tree TypeScript, real Frequency compile and all six local artifact gates pass at 87e7acd77. Production remains unchanged.

verify.note: Execute all three actual metadata exports with parent file-card descriptors; require images, page-specific Twitter copy and preserved canonicals. Normal CI retains 24 Help/schema/raster tests. Production release verification remains separate.
